name: PT Citatah Tbk
summary: PT Citatah Tbk engages in mining, processing, marketing, and distribution of marble, natural stone, and mosaic products in Indonesia and internationally. The company operates through Limestone and Imported Building Materials segments. It offers products for commercial and residential projects for interior and exterior applications. The company also provides granite, onyx, limestone, traventine, sandstone, quartzite, labradorite, semiprecious stone, soap stone, travertine, quartz surface, technological and technical stone, ecological stone, and glass mosaic under the Bisazza, Caesarstone, Geoluxe, and Nextep brand names.
